page_title: LAZ 1-0 LEC | Lazio v Lecce 14/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
90+3' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
90+3' Felipe Anderson (Lazio) plays a lovely through ball to Ciro Immobile, but he can't beat Wladimiro Falcone and loses the ball.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Matias Vecino (Lazio) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
87' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Pedro (Lazio). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
87' Ciro Immobile (Lazio) meets a cross inside the box, but his header is blocked by an opposing player. Lazio have a corner.
85' Roberto D'Aversa decides to make a substitution. Remi Oudin will be replaced by Roberto Piccoli (Lecce).
85' Substitution. Antonino Gallo leaves the pitch and is replaced by Patrick Dorgu (Lecce).
81' Tempers flare after Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) commits a foul. He receives a yellow card for his bad challenge and surely must be relieved at not receiving a red card.
79' It is time for a substitution. Ciro Immobile (Lazio) is on for Mattia Zaccagni.
77' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
77' The current number of corner kicks is 1:5.
76' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
76' Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Lazio force a corner. They send men into the box.
75' Lorenzo Venuti (Lecce) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

74' A cross by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
72' Substitution. Gabriel Strefezza replaces Joan Gonzalez (Lecce).
72' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alexis Blin (Lecce) comes onto the pitch so that Mohamed Kaba can be given a rest.
70' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

68' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) blows a huge opportunity! He latches on to a perfect cross from the wing into the penalty area, but sends his bullet header just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
67' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Luca Pellegrini trots off the pitch and is replaced by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
65' Maurizio Sarri has decided to make a change. Matias Vecino (Lazio) replaces Luis Alberto.
64' Luis Alberto (Lazio) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
63' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) but poses no threat.
61' Remi Oudin (Lecce) attempts to find Joan Gonzalez, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
58' 1 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Felipe Anderson (Lazio) was set free in the area by Luis Alberto and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the top of the net. 1:0.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Lorenzo Venuti (Lecce) comes onto the pitch for Valentin Gendrey.
56' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
54' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.

51' Pedro (Lazio) creates some space for himself to pick up a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a decent strike which goes a whisker over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
49' Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Wladimiro Falcone comes off the line to clear the ball away.
46' Maurizio Sarri makes a half-time substitution. Pedro comes on in place of Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
46' The second half has just started.
46' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Maria Caputi pulls out a yellow card.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
45' Mattia Zaccagni (Lazio) commits a rough foul. Maria Caputi stops the game and makes a call.
42' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
42' The corner kick from Remi Oudin (Lecce) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
41' A cross into the box from Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) is cleared. Now Lecce have a corner.
40' Pontus Almqvist (Lecce) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
38' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
38' Wonderful movement by Lecce. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
34' Marin Pongracic (Lecce) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the left post.
34' Remi Oudin (Lecce) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
34' Mohamed Kaba (Lecce) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Ivan Provedel anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
31' Remi Oudin (Lecce) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
31' Valentin Gendrey (Lecce) tries to find Nikola Krstovic, but he puts too much power on the pass.
26' Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) commits a foul and Maria Caputi immediately signals a free kick.
26' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
24' Problems for Maurizio Sarri as Patric (Lazio) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Alessio Romagnoli replaces him.
23' Patric (Lazio) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
20' Total attempts – 2:3.
17' Remi Oudin (Lecce) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
17' Remi Oudin (Lecce) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Good work from Lecce as they win a corner.
13' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Wladimiro Falcone is alert and denies him.
12' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Ivan Provedel.

12' Lecce slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
10' So close! Luis Alberto (Lazio) delivers a cross into the box, it almost finds the head of one of his teammates, but one of the defenders is quickest to the ball and coolly deals with the threat.
7' Referee Maria Caputi sees the trip by Nicolo Rovella (Lazio) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick is awarded to Lecce.
6' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
5' Remi Oudin (Lecce) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
5' This shall not pass! Remi Oudin (Lecce) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. Lecce will take a corner kick.

2' Luis Alberto (Lazio) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Mattia Zaccagni was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lazio will have the kick-off.
Maria Caputi will supervise the game today.
